claims.claim: LG Washing machine scrap but doesn't work and needs repair
claims.evidence: Photo shows door closed, display lit with orange icons, but no operation is shown; cannot confirm working or non-working state remotely.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year
claims.evidence: Photo shows some surface marks/stains near the sticker and a worn/patched wall behind it, which is inconclusive about usage age.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened
claims.evidence: This directly contradicts the seller's own earlier statement in the same message that the unit 'doesn't work and needs repair' — an internal inconsistency, not something the photo can resolve.
No receipt or warranty card is visible in the photo; would need a separate image to confirm.

risks.risk: Actual working state of wash and dry cycles is unknown and seller's own description is contradictory
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on, a wash cycle starting, and a dry cycle starting with sound

risks.risk: Internal condition of drum, bearings, motor, seals, and hoses cannot be seen
risks.proof: Close-up photos/video of open door drum, door seal, and hose connections at the back
risks.if_unproven: price as needing parts/repair, worst case

risks.risk: Surface stains near control panel could indicate corrosion, leakage, or heat damage affecting electronics
risks.proof: Close-up, well-lit photo of the stained area and the full control panel
risks.if_unproven: price as cosmetically and possibly electrically compromised

risks.risk: Seller's contradictory claims (scrap/non-working vs. barely-used/no-fault) raise risk of misrepresentation or a swapped/faulty unit being sold as near-new
risks.proof: A clear video call or recorded walk-around showing serial number, power-on behavior, and matching receipt/warranty card with serial number
risks.if_unproven: price at worst case (non-working, unverified history) and treat claims of 'new/no fault' as unsupported

risks.risk: Completeness of accessories (inlet/outlet hoses, power cord condition, manual) is unknown
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out next to the unit

proof_requests: Video of the unit powered on, attempting a wash cycle and a dry cycle, with audible sound
Close-up photos of the drum interior, door seal, and rear hose connections
Close-up, well-lit photo of the stained/marked area on the front panel
Photo of the serial number plate (usually on the back or inside the door) matching the receipt/warranty card
Photo of the receipt and warranty card itself
Photo of all accessories (hoses, manual, power cord) included
response.reason: The seller's own message is self-contradictory, claiming the unit both 'doesn't work and needs repair' and has 'no fault at all,' which is a red flag; until resolved, the unit should be treated at worst case as non-working scrap pending verification.
